L'analyse des indicateurs de données mon: Data indicator analysis shows that Djezzy outperformed its competitors on most metrics. This includes access success rates for downlink and uplink connections. However, the results are tight: Mobilis takes the lead on "lite" data tasks and Ooredoo on the downlink.
Au niveau de la voix, Djezzy enregistre: On voice performance, Djezzy records the fastest call setup time. Mobilis posts the lowest blocked call rate (0.58%), but with a longer setup time (7.6 seconds).
Concernant la 5G, Ooredoo se distingue à: Regarding 5G, Ooredoo stands out in Algiers with 76% of samples connected to 5G (3.5 GHz band), compared to 30% for Djezzy. Mobilis is currently focusing on the LTE network.
